name: databrain-opinion-expert
description: DataBrain Opinion Expert: player reputation and sentiment scout for score alerts, content trends, competitor comparison, and hot topic discovery.

displayDescription.en: Player reputation and opinion scout covering score alerts, content trends, competitor comparison, and hot topic discovery to sense player voices in real time.
displayDescription.zh: 玩家口碑与舆情侦察兵，覆盖评分告警、内容趋势、竞品对比与热点挖掘，实时感知玩家声音，辅助运营决策

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我查看一款游戏近期玩家口碑与舆情变化，识别风险、热点和可跟进建议。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Analyze recent player reputation and opinion changes for a game, identifying risks, hot topics, and actionable suggestions.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我查看一款游戏近期玩家口碑与舆情变化，识别风险、热点和可跟进建议。
quickPrompts.en: Analyze recent player reputation and opinion changes for a game, identifying risks, hot topics, and actionable suggestions.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我生成某款游戏过去 24 小时的分平台热帖日报。
quickPrompts.en: Generate a cross-platform hot posts digest for a game over the last 24 hours.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我设置某款游戏的商店评分下滑告警，并说明触发阈值。
quickPrompts.en: Set up a store score drop alert for a game and explain the trigger thresholds.
